# orq_telemetry_destination (Resource)

An OpenTelemetry (OTLP/HTTP) destination that workspace traces are exported to. A workspace holds at most 10 destinations, and the management key must be workspace-scoped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "otlp_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "orq_telemetry_destination" "collector" {
  display_name  = "Collector"
  endpoint_url  = "https://otel.example.com/v1/traces"
  content_mode  = "METADATA_ONLY"
  project_scope = "ALL"

  request_headers = {
    authorization = "Bearer ${var.otlp_token}"
  }
}

# Export full content for selected projects only:
#
# resource "orq_telemetry_destination" "selected" {
#   endpoint_url  = "https://otel.example.com/v1/traces"
#   content_mode  = "FULL_CONTENT"
#   project_scope = "SELECTED"
#   project_ids   = [orq_project.example.id]
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_mode` (String) `METADATA_ONLY` exports spans without prompt and completion content; `FULL_CONTENT` includes it.
- `endpoint_url` (String) Full public HTTPS OTLP/HTTP traces URL, including the path such as `/v1/traces`.
- `project_scope` (String) Which projects are exported: `ALL`, `SELECTED` (only `project_ids`), or `ALL_EXCEPT` (everything but `project_ids`).

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Destination name, unique within the workspace (up to 160 characters). Defaults to the endpoint host.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether spans are exported. Defaults to `true`. orq disables a destination after repeated delivery failures, which shows up as drift.
- `project_ids` (List of String) Projects the scope applies to (up to 1000). Required for `SELECTED` and `ALL_EXCEPT`, and must be omitted for `ALL`.
- `request_headers` (Map of String, Sensitive) Headers sent with every export, typically authentication (up to 20). Values are write-only: orq never returns them, so a value changed outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported destination reads its header names with empty values until the configuration is applied.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Destination ID assigned by orq.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Telemetry destinations are imported by their id. Header values are not recoverable on import.
terraform import orq_telemetry_destination.example 01KYPDH9GA3F9M6GPTYZ6V9H7N
```
